title: paeonia japonica f. pilosa
intro: Paeonia japonica f. pilosa, commonly known as the Japanese peony, is a species of flowering plant in the family Paeoniaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia japonica f. pilosa include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
